tools.name: check_discovery_documents
tools.title: Which discovery documents does this host serve?
tools.description: Probes 22 documents agents and trust indexes ask for — llms.txt, agent card, owners.json, oauth metadata, mcp.json, apis.json, openapi, robots, sitemap — as served, missing, gated or 200-with-HTML soft-404, and says who asks for each missing one. Refuses private, ephemeral and its own hosts. Example: host='example.com'.

host.description: Hostname to check. https is assumed.

groups.description: Subset: agent, mcp, api, web, or all (default).

mcp_path.description: MCP endpoint path, e.g. /mcp: also checks documents relative to it.

tools.name: explain_document
tools.title: What is this document, and who reads it?
tools.description: One catalogue entry: what the document is for, the named clients observed asking this host for it with dates and the status they took, what a 404 costs, and the spec URL. No argument lists all 22. Example: name='owners.json' names the bot that asks for it twice.

name.description: Document name or path, e.g. owners.json. Omit for the catalogue.

tools.name: validate_llms_txt
tools.title: Check a pasted llms.txt
tools.description: Checks pasted llms.txt against the format: one H1, a blockquote summary, H2 sections of `- [name](url): notes`. Errors and warnings with line numbers and fixes, plus the parsed links. Text in, nothing fetched. Example: text='# Site' warns it has no summary and no sections.

text.description: The llms.txt content itself, not a URL.

examples.text:
# Site

> One line.

## Docs

- [Guide](https://e.com/g): start here.

tools.name: llms_txt_from_sitemap
tools.title: Draft an llms.txt from a sitemap
tools.description: Paste sitemap.xml, or one URL per line, and get a draft llms.txt: URLs grouped into H2 sections by path, titles from slugs, lastmod kept, and a TODO wherever only you can write the sentence. A sitemap index is reported as one. Example: xml='https://e.com/docs/a\nhttps://e.com/blog/b'.

xml.description: The sitemap XML, or a plain list of URLs.

title.description: H1 to use; default from the hostname.

tools.name: validate_agent_card
tools.title: Check a pasted A2A agent card
tools.description: Validates a pasted /.well-known/agent-card.json against the nine fields A2A marks required and each skill's id/name/description/tags, and warns on capabilities declared true that a reader will then try. Example: json='{"name":"a"}' returns the eight missing fields.

json.description: The agent card JSON itself, not a URL.

io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo.name: agent-discovery-doctor
io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo.title: Agent Discovery Doctor
io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo.description: Checks which agent-discovery documents a host publishes — llms.txt, the A2A agent card, owners.json, oauth-protected-resource, apis.json, mcp.json, openapi, robots, sitemap — names the validators observed asking for each one, says what a 404 costs, and validates or drafts the documents from pasted text.
